final_message: I wrote all the Playwright specs, but none of them have been run. I couldn't run them while the builder works, and I didn't read `src/`, `server/` or `shared/`. Everything is in `e2e/`: - **Shared helpers:** `helpers.ts` holds the reset call, account switching, the date helper and the listing and booking helpers. - **Acceptance cases:** `case-TR-1.spec.ts` through `case-TR-6.spec.ts`, one `test('TR-n: …')` each. They use the supplied values, including 2026-12-01→2026-12-04 for the $280.00 pricing and approval cases. The conflict case uses 2026-11-11→2026-11-14 against seed booking `book_301`. - **Journey:** `journey.spec.ts` is the full renter-books, owner-approves flow with a reload at the end. It books through the UI and doesn't reuse a seed booking. - **Edge cases:** `edge-cases.spec.ts` has three checks. The first covers invalid booking dates and the second an empty listing form. The third covers the empty filter state and negative max price. - **Smoke:** `smoke.spec.ts` covers every route for both roles, the car-not-found page and the access-denied pages, and fails on any `pageerror`. - **Visual:** `visual.spec.ts` has six serial tests (catalog, booking and requests, each at 1440×900 and 390×844). Each one checks for no horizontal overflow, labelled controls and keyboard focus, then writes `visual-evidence/{desktop|mobile}-{id}.png` and attaches it. The specs rely on contract details the builder has to match, since I couldn't check them: - Accounts are switched only through the `account-switcher` select (no localStorage key was specified). Switching is assumed to navigate to `/` and persist across reloads. - Create responses (`POST /api/cars` and `POST /api/bookings`) are assumed to return JSON with an `id`. The 409 conflict status for `POST /api/bookings` and a 200 from the status `PATCH` are also asserted. - Date inputs must accept Playwright `fill('YYYY-MM-DD')`. - Client-side date errors must show as soon as both dates are set. - The booking-error texts must match the spec exactly. The test for the "Rentals are limited to 30 days" error uses a 40-day range. - `field-*-error` elements must appear for an empty form submit. The model, daily rate and pickup address errors are asserted as present, and only the brand text is asserted exactly. - The visual test asserts every visible `` has loaded after scrolling, so remote images must load. A failed image has to be replaced by an `image-fallback` element, not left as a broken ``. - The TR-1 and TR-6 persistence checks assume the marketplace shows a decimal price like `$64.50/day`. - The seed is assumed to have exactly one renter booking for Alex Rivera. TR-5 and the date edge test count bookings and expect 1.
